Examine land animals for cloven hoof and cud
Only cloven-hoofed cud-chewers are food; the AHS species schedule, printed on every menu.
Do not eat the camel, coney, hare, or swine
The four named exclusions; the Pork Question nearly broke the founding convention — bacon lost, the smugglers' fortune was made.
Eat only finned and scaled water creatures
Fins and scales required; the shrimp fleet converted to 'export only' in a single fiscal year.
Do not eat what lacks fins and scales
Shellfish are abomination; the Gulf coast's economy is one long asterisk.
Do not eat the listed birds of prey and carrion birds
The unclean bird list; poultry certification descends from it.
Do not eat winged creeping things
Insects forbidden save the exceptions; the protein-bar industry litigated cricket flour to the Council and lost.
The four leaping insects are permitted
Locust, bald locust, beetle, grasshopper; permitted, unmarketed, a survivalist novelty.
Do not eat creeping things of the ground
Whatsoever goeth upon the belly; escargot joined shrimp in exile.
Do not eat any abominable thing
The general clause; the catch-all under which novel foods are adjudicated — lab-grown meat's hearing lasted three years.
The duty of discernment itself; AHS food labels carry a CLEAN seal, counterfeited constantly.
Do not sow the field with mixed seed (kilayim)
No mingled seed; monoculture got a divine mandate, seed companies quote Leviticus in annual reports.
Do not sow the vineyard with mixed seed
Mixed vineyard plantings are forfeit; vineyard interplanting requires an AHS variance.
Do not plow with ox and ass together
No mixed-species yoking; construed to regulate mixed-power machinery pairings, absurdly.
Do not wear wool and linen together (shatnez)
No mingled fabric; garment tags carry BRC fiber certification, the fashion industry's compliance arm is enormous.
No diverse-kind breeding; the mule question was resolved by grandfather clause, literally.
Do not eat orlah (fruit of the first three years)
Young trees' fruit forbidden three years; orchard registries date-stamp every planting.
The fourth year's fruit is holy
Fourth-year fruit praised to God; commuted to the Fourth-Year Levy on orchards.
Do not reap the field's corners
Leave the corners for the poor; codified, mapped, and fenced 'pending gleaning-safety rulemaking' for thirty years.
Leave the corners (peah) for the poor
The affirmative twin; the Gleaner's Card queue is the rulemaking.
Dropped stalks belong to the poor; supermarket 'ugly produce' programs claim the mantle, cynically.
Leave the fallen grapes and vineyard gleanings
The vineyard's leavings for the poor and stranger.
The forgotten sheaf is the widow's and orphan's; logistics software made forgetting impossible, which the AHS ruled 'constructive compliance.'
Do not return for the forgotten sheaf
The negative twin; route-optimization patches were mandated, then unfunded.
Do not glean your own vineyard bare
Total harvest is forbidden; combine-harvester efficiency settings were briefly capped — the lobbying war of the decade.
The passerby may eat grapes in your vineyard
Field-eating rights on the spot; codified, gated behind the Gleaner's Card.
The passerby shall not carry any away
No vessel-filling; THIS half is enforced with cameras — the right starves, the limit thrives.
The passerby may pluck ears by hand
Hand-plucking in standing grain; Jesus's disciples exercised it (Mt 12:1), the card office notes.
The passerby shall not use a sickle
No sickle on a neighbor's grain; the enforced half, again.
Do not muzzle the ox treading grain
Working animals eat as they work; Paul made it clergy pay (1 Cor 9:9) and so did the TFRS.
Bring the firstfruits to the sanctuary
The basket of firstfruits with the wandering-Aramean recital; the Firstfruits Assessment plus a mandatory recorded recital, kept on file.
'A Syrian ready to perish was my father'; the recital's immigrant gratitude is read aloud yearly by a state that admits no immigrants — no one laughs on camera.
Tithe the first tithe to the Levites
Ten percent to the Levites; the Tithe, payroll-withheld, the TFRS's reason for being.
Levites tithe the tithe to the priests
The tithe of the tithe; intra-clergy revenue sharing, audited savagely.
Tithe the second tithe and eat it at the place
The festival consumption tithe, convertible to money for the journey; survives as the Festival Travel Account — the one tax citizens like.
Give the poor tithe in the third year
Every third year the tithe goes to the Levite, stranger, fatherless, widow; the Third-Year Redistribution is announced triennially and 'phased' perpetually.
The solemn declaration of tithe compliance; the annual Tithe Attestation, signed under blasphemy exposure.
Do not delay offerings and tithes
'Thou shalt not delay'; late tithes accrue the Contrition Surcharge.
Do not eat the second tithe in mourning or unclean
The tithe eaten in joy and cleanness; Festival Travel Accounts freeze during bereavement, cruelly.
Let the land rest the seventh year (shemitah)
The land's sabbath; the Fallow Mandate applies to smallholders, agribusiness holds 'continuous-cultivation research waivers.'
Do not sow or prune in the seventh year
The negative twin; drone surveillance enforces it on exactly the farms too small to have lawyers.
Do not reap the seventh year's aftergrowth as harvest
Volunteer growth belongs to all; the commons clause, fenced.
The seventh year's produce is free to all
Open access for servant, stranger, and beast; the DLJ's least-visited webpage.
Release debts in the seventh year (shemitat kesafim)
Every creditor releases his neighbor's debt; the Release is 'under actuarial study' — the study's budget exceeds most agencies.
Do not exact debt after the release
No collection past the seventh year; the banking system exists because this is deferred.
Do not refuse to lend as the release approaches
The 'base thought' clause — refusing credit before release is sin; scored, never enforced, the credit industry's favorite dead letter.
Assemble the people in the seventh year (hakhel)
The septennial reading of the law; the one shemitah clause the regime loves — a broadcast spectacle.
The forty-nine-year count toward Jubilee; the DLJ's Jubilee Actuarial Office keeps the count with exquisite care and no intention.
Sound the trumpet on the Jubilee
Liberty proclaimed throughout the land; the words are on the Liberty Bell the regime did not melt and cannot ring.
Hallow the fiftieth year; proclaim liberty
Land returns, bondmen go free; CSC 1-03: 'requires a functioning Temple' — the load-bearing deferral of the whole economy.
Do not sow or reap in the Jubilee
The Jubilee fallow; moot by deferral.
Land returns to its family in the Jubilee
Every man unto his possession; the Land Registry maintains 'reversion shadow-titles' for every parcel — the most dangerous database in the country.
Do not sell land in perpetuity
'The land is mine; ye are strangers and sojourners with me'; all USofC land sales are formally 99-year leases against the shadow-titles, a fiction everyone prices in.
Kinsman redemption of family land; the Right of Familial Repurchase survives — the one Jubilee fragment enforced, because the wealthy use it.
Houses in walled cities: one-year redemption
Urban homes redeemable one year, then permanent; the urban/rural title distinction, mapped onto zoning.
Levitical property never alienates; church real estate is inalienable, hence the denominations are land banks.
Do not sell the Levites' pasture lands
The glebe is permanent; parsonage-land law.
'Thou shalt relieve him'; the affirmative welfare command, implemented as faith-based block grants that mostly build gymnasiums.
Do not take interest from your brother
No usury from the covenant poor; CSC 1-04 construed 'brother' to same-congregation lending — the mortgage industry's charter.
Do not pay interest to your brother (borrower's ban)
The borrower also sins; deferred with the rest, cited by debt-strike movements the DOR calls heretical.
Lend to the foreigner at interest
'Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury'; the sovereign-debt desk's proof-text, engraved in its lobby.
'If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor'; read as permissive by the banks, imperative by the preachers, and 'aspirational' by CSC.
Do not demand payment of the insolvent
Be not as an usurer to him; collections law's ghost clause.
Do not take the mill or millstone in pledge
No taking a man's livelihood as security; tools-of-trade exemption in the bankruptcy code, genuinely humane, genuinely enforced.
Do not enter the debtor's house to take the pledge
Stand outside; the repossession-at-the-door rule, beloved of civil libertarians who hate everything else here.
Return the poor man's pledge by sundown
The garment pledge returns nightly; payday-loan collateral must be 'sundown-returnable,' an actual compliance category.
Do not keep the widow's garment in pledge
The widow's raiment is untouchable; one of the few poor-law clauses with teeth, because the optics are unsurvivable.
Do not withhold the hired servant's wages overnight
'At his day thou shalt give him his hire'; the Daily Wage Rule — gig platforms pay at sundown by statute, their one genuine improvement.
Do not oppress the hired servant
No oppression of the poor and needy laborer, citizen or alien; the OSO's mission statement and its counter-example.
Pay the laborer the same day
'Neither shall the sun go down upon it'; James 4:1-5:4 thunders it at the rich — the passage is read at every labor rally and never in the Council chapel.
Do not pervert the alien's or orphan's wage claim
No perverting the stranger's judgment; wage-theft claims by non-communicants queue separately, i.e., forever.
Give to the poor what suffices his need
'Thou shalt open thine hand wide'; sufficiency was defined by regulation at 62% of sufficiency.
Do not harden your heart against the poor
The heart statute; unenforceable, confessed weekly, unchanged.
Give the freed servant liberal severance
'Thou shalt furnish him liberally'; the Release Endowment at bond expiry — funded at a rate the word 'liberally' sues over annually.
Keep just balances, weights, and measures
Just weights; the BWM's charter, the regime's one universally loved agency.
Do not falsify weights and measures
No unrighteousness in meteyard, weight, or measure; software scales are BWM-sealed at the chip level.
Do not keep diverse weights in your bag
No dual sets of weights; dual-pricing algorithms were ruled 'diverse weights in the bag' — the great fintech case.
Do not defraud in buying and selling
'Ye shall not oppress one another' in sale; the consumer-fraud omnibus.
Do not wrong with words (ona'at devarim)
Oppression by speech; deceptive-advertising law wears this verse.
The civil restatement of the eighth commandment; the restitution schedule's hook.
Do not lie to one another
The general falsehood ban; applied to commerce, waived — case by case — for statecraft.
Do not defraud your neighbor or rob him
No withholding by force or fraud; the RA's civil docket.
The robber restores principal plus a fifth; the Contrition Surcharge again.
Return lost property to your brother
Lost ox, ass, raiment, 'all lost things'; the national Lost Property Registry — unclaimed property law with a conscience clause.
Do not pretend you did not see the lost thing
'Thou mayest not hide thyself'; the duty-to-notice clause, cited against platforms that 'don't see' stolen goods.
Help your brother's fallen beast rise
Raise the fallen ass even of your enemy; the roadside-duty statute, Good Samaritan law's grumpy ancestor.
Do not move your neighbor's landmark
Ancient boundaries stand; survey fraud is a Covenant felony, GPS notwithstanding — the shadow-title registry watches.
